mainFrameComparison.scope: One window per version/cell, no reversed frame matrix. The inventory reversal does not close or explain the independently observed frame slowdowns.

requiredDisclosure4kEternal.scope: One measured window per version. The current build has a much longer retained interval and did not expose the target loot-7 stage during its measured window; this case remains an open software-renderer performance/coverage risk.

duplicateHtml.action: No data deleted or changed. A future package-only content-addressed HTML directory and explicit original-path-to-SHA manifest could share identical bytes, provided replay readers resolve aliases and every original report remains intact. Keeping all present files is simpler at this small byte scale.

interpretation.inventory: The direction reverses between complete batches after reversing context creation order. These data do not support a stable speed improvement or a fixed version-caused slowdown. This is an association with batch/order conditions, not proof that creation order is the bottleneck. All 48 timed inventory samples and four excluded-but-retained warmups remain visible.
interpretation.frames: The main matrix uses one window per cell. Current-build maximum intervals are longer in 13/16 paired cells, including all 8 eternal-open cells; this signal needs to remain visible even though its repeatability and version attribution are not established. No reversed frame matrix was measured. All five unobserved full-effect windows and every slow callback remain in the data. Near-16.7ms p50 and the fixed floor-rank p95/p99 can coexist with single multi-second gaps; use complete traces/max/overrun to assess stalls.
interpretation.stateAndDom: Offline checks validate artifact bytes, hashes, all 60 complete card pairs, lossless differences, every recorded state/DOM assertion and cross-scene committed-state hash consistency. Full decoded browser saves and a fresh native DOM parse were not re-executed in this offline review; those exact comparisons are performed by the recorded, fingerprinted measurement script.
interpretation.longTasks: Only two long tasks were recorded across 6204 RAF intervals in the main run. Missing long-task entries during large callback gaps do not identify the responsible subsystem or establish that the browser/main thread was fast.
interpretation.hardware: ANGLE SwiftShader software-rendered Chromium data are not physical GPU or physical 4K60 validation.

offlineHarnessCorrection: The first offline audit assumed --source contained the new measurement script. In the intentionally reversed batch --source is the old tree, while the same current-tree script drives both origins. The checker now locates the fingerprinted script in either mapped tree. The initial offline path error is retained separately and is not a product or measurement failure.

chineseReviewConclusion.inventory: 两批按实际版本映射后背包变化方向反转；不支持稳定提速或固定版本回退归因，不应单凭首批噪声回滚功能，也不能宣称性能无回归。
chineseReviewConclusion.frames: 主矩阵当前版本最大间隔在13/16对更长，永恒开箱8/8均更长；每格只有一次且没有反转帧矩阵，重复性和因果归因未确定。必须保留公开风险。
chineseReviewConclusion.requiredDisclosure: 3840×2160 永恒开箱 full 最大间隔 3005.8→8993.4 ms，当前窗口未观察到 loot-7；此风险不能由1920品质覆盖或背包反转结果关闭。
chineseReviewConclusion.measurementScope: 软件Chromium/SwiftShader、回调间隔数据，非实体GPU、实体4K60或私人玩家存档认证。
